text: Targets the exchange-rate HTTP calls (about 2801s of 3061s cumulative, roughly 92%) as the only change that matters
Rejects the Cython rewrite of format_row, noting it accounts for roughly 94s and cannot move the total meaningfully
Rejects parallelizing sort_rows, noting it is about 28s of a 3061s run
Quantifies the ceiling on the rejected optimizations, for example that eliminating both entirely saves under 5% of wall clock
Proposes the structural fix: cache or batch the exchange-rate lookups, since 240310 calls almost certainly resolve to a small set of currency pairs and dates
Notes the roughly 12ms per call and that the calls are serial, so batching or concurrency is the lever
Output is structured as a performance analysis with Goal, Baseline, Profile Summary, and Recommendations sections
Each recommendation names its expected improvement and its trade-off, for example rate staleness from caching
